note: v1.md section 4.3. `original_headers` are the header fields of the original request in the order received (an entry with `times` stands for that many identical fields in a row). `expect` is the envelope evidence: `signature_headers`, `omitted_header_names`, `omitted_header_count`, `evidence_complete`.

cases.title: A usual Cavage request. Order: signature, then the covered names in the order of the headers parameter, then the remaining fixed names. user-agent and accept are not candidates.
Names are stored in lowercase; values are kept as received.
content-type and date are covered by the signature and also in the fixed list: each field appears once, at its first position.
Two date fields: both are kept, in the original order.
The signature covers authorization and x-api-key: both are omitted (named, counted). A cookie that nothing refers to is not a candidate and is not counted.
Signature-Input components (covered-component parameters are ignored, pseudo-components starting with @ are skipped). Group 1 keeps signature fields in the original order.

A component parameter value holds an escaped quote and a space. The escaped quote does not end the string, so the next covered component, cookie, is found: it is secret-bearing, so it is omitted and counted.
A parameter value with an escaped backslash and parentheses does not confuse the parser: the covered x-extra is kept and nothing is omitted.
(request-target), (created) and @method are not header fields: not kept, not omitted.
The kept headers use exactly EVIDENCE_BUDGET_BYTES. Nothing is omitted and the evidence is complete.
One byte more and x-pad is omitted whole (never truncated); its name still fits and is listed.
After x-pad the budget is full. date and content-type no longer fit and are omitted; there is no room left to list their names, so only the count reflects them.
x-big does not fit and is omitted; the later, smaller digest and content-type are still kept.
A value with a non-ASCII character, and a value longer than EVIDENCE_HEADER_VALUE_MAX, are omitted, not altered.
A header name longer than EVIDENCE_HEADER_NAME_MAX cannot be kept and cannot be listed (the schema bounds the listed names): it is only counted.
More distinct omitted names than OMITTED_NAMES_MAX: the first OMITTED_NAMES_MAX are listed, the count covers all of them.

The omitted count stops at OMITTED_COUNT_MAX (1024).
